identity.motif: F#-C#-G-F# zigzag in dotted sixteenths (3+3+3+3+2+2), the G natural as a flash
identity.relation_to_thorns: Same ensemble and minor-key combat pulse; 40 BPM faster, F# not C, syncopated 3+3+2 instead of Thorns' even eighths.

key: F# minor; Phrygian G-natural flashes, German-sixth D7 and C#7(b9) strikes
mood: Lightning boss: a jagged dotted-sixteenth zigzag over 3+3+2 stabs, restless tremolo and crackle.
palette: Thorns in the Dark v02 string ensemble (violins/viola over pluck, bass, restrained drums)
sections: 1-8: the zigzag strike over 3+3+2 stabs (F#m-D7-C#7 | F#m-Bm-G-C#7b9)
9-16: rising answer; second violins shadow the motif in fourths; motif on B minor
17-24: eye of the storm - augmented motif sequenced D-E-F#m under tremolo, tom roll
25-32: full strike with crackle and backbeat, tutti Neapolitan stabs, diminished fall
title: Zekarion, the Raging Tempest
